intent: Refactor: extract the duplicated cents-to-euros formatting into one helper. No behavior change.
review_guide:
Money is an integer number of cents everywhere in this repo; dividing by 100 and calling toFixed(2) is the house format.
A pure extraction refactor needs no new test when the callers' existing tests (test/invoice.test.ts, test/receipt.test.ts) cover the moved code.

files.src/format/money.ts:
diff --git a/src/format/money.ts b/src/format/money.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/format/money.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+// Integer cents to the house display format: 1234 -> "12.34 EUR".
+export const formatCents = (cents: number): string => `${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)} EUR`;
